description: This file defines a utility function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections 'session_tracking' and 'llm_costs'. It processes and merges data from different structures, normalizes currency strings, and supports filtering options. The main purpose is to provide a summarized view of agent usage and costs across sessions.

methods.name: toNumberSafe
methods.description: Parses currency-like strings safely into numbers, handling various formats and null/undefined inputs.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
methods.description: Main function that aggregates agent costs and usage from MongoDB collections with filtering and normalization.
